Improved Entropy-Based Centrality

Source: R/centrality-batch67.R
centrality_improved_entropy.Rd

The improved entropy-based centrality of Ni et al. (2020) adds a node's direct influence, from the spread of its tie weights and of its neighbors' degrees, and its indirect influence on the nodes two steps away: $$I_i = \tfrac{1}{2} DI_i + \tfrac{1}{2} II_i, \qquad DI_i = \tfrac{1}{2} H(p_{i\cdot}) + \tfrac{1}{2} H(T_{i\cdot}), \qquad T_{ij} = \frac{k_j^{\beta}}{\sum_{l \in N(i)} k_l^{\beta}},$$ with \(H\) the entropy to base 10 over the neighbors, \(p_{ij}\) the share of the weight of \(i\) on its tie to \(j\) and \(k\) the degree. \(II_i\) averages, over the nodes two steps away, \(DI_i\) times the mean \(DI\) of the neighbors they share with \(i\).

Usage

centrality_improved_entropy(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality. The measure uses ie_beta (the exponent of the neighbor degree, default 2).

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order.

Details

The measure uses the edge weights. With weighted = FALSE, or on an unweighted network, \(H(p_{i\cdot}) = \log_{10} k_i\). The source defines it for undirected networks; when the weighted adjacency matrix is not symmetric the measure warns (class cograph_undefined_measure) and returns NA. Loops are ignored. ie_beta = 2 and the mixing weights of 1/2 are the source's basic values (its section 5); the mixing weights are fixed. A node two steps away shares a neighbor with \(i\) and is not adjacent to it. A node with no such node has indirect influence 0, where the source leaves 0/0; an isolated node scores 0. The source prints no value of the measure, so the implementation is checked against the definition only. This is the measure the Centrality Zoo describes as the improved entropy-based centrality; the Zoo's entry also cites Peng et al. (2017), whose different measure is centrality_entropy_influence. On four test networks the score ranks nodes closest to ked and lnc (mean Kendall correlation 0.93); with the measure of Peng et al. it has 0.85 to 0.93. A ie_beta that is not a single finite number raises a cograph_bad_parameter error, and negative weights a cograph_negative_weights error. normalized = TRUE divides the scores by their maximum.

References

Ni, C., Yang, J. and Kong, D. (2020). Sequential seeding strategy for social influence diffusion with improved entropy-based centrality. Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, 545, 123659. doi:10.1016/j.physa.2019.123659 .

See also

centrality_entropy_influence, centrality_entropy, centrality.

Examples

centrality_improved_entropy(to_undirected(regulation_net))
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>  0.5873504  0.6203873  0.6868462  0.6334209  0.5547494  0.5900044  0.4747818 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>  0.5794531  0.6493129  0.6005726 
centrality_improved_entropy(to_undirected(regulation_net), ie_beta = 0)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>  0.5941110  0.6336524  0.6977712  0.6465333  0.5696051  0.5970275  0.4833657 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>  0.5876161  0.6592209  0.6079290
